changelog:
2018 Hardware Runs 2026 Designs.

System WebView default path: compatibility layer for old engines, missing APIs polyfilled, 32-bit memory exhaustion self-heals. Reaches Chromium 69. Modern CSS no longer breaks, popup cards stay in viewport, calendar cards stop flashing. Browser sidebar page zoom bidirectional with HA. Off-screen cards pause layout, WebSocket steps down under screensaver, CSS/media pause when hidden. Lower CPU/GPU than 0.7.3, better touch response. Path: Settings → Display & Browser.

Experimental: Stop-word echo handling with playback reference subtraction. Bayesian occupancy fusion: face, motion, touch, vibration, proximity, voiceprint into single probability. Path: Settings → Advanced → Experimental.

Floating window all Android versions: 7-9 system freeform, 10+ scrcpy virtual display mirror.

Fixes: update popup reappearing, sidebar handle sizing, screensaver WebView inherits font/dark mode, brightness fallback, service widget states, music widget artist/progress, sensor widget history backfill, corner icon preference. Sendspin bidirectional progress: seek syncs both sides, track change reseats timeline, metadata clears on unpair. Fleet: HA device page Visit button opens console. Thanks @ds2000 #204.
